method: Every final move has an actual Stockfish evaluation. Opening commitments are explicit and excluded from a claim of globally optimal opening choice. Outside those commitments, generated best moves or checked alternatives lose at most 30 centipawns under the stated search. This is a finite engine check, not a proof of absolute optimality. Theory prefixes or transposed positions link to a pinned CC0 source. The master database required OAuth and was not used.
